# markvis (full)

Quantitative Markdown charts. Path: fence | GFM | HTML comment → parser → Chart IR → SVG + table fallback.

## Grammar

1. Optional `markvis: 2`
2. Headers: `type`, `title`, `unit`, `x`, `y`, `series`
3. Blank line
4. CSV or GFM table with a header row

Language tags `chart`, `markvis`, `vis` share one parser.

## Types

| type | notes |
| --- | --- |
| bar | keep row order |
| line | multi-series via `series`; keep row order |
| area | same order rule as line |
| scatter | numeric x and y |
| pie | values ≥ 0; do not normalize to 100 |
| hist | continuous x; table keeps raw rows |

## Errors (stable codes)

E_UNKNOWN_TYPE, E_TYPE_TYPO, E_JSON_DATA, E_MISSING_HEADER, E_EMPTY_DATA, E_EXTRA_COLUMN, E_DUP_COLUMN, E_UNKNOWN_FIELD, E_PIE_NEGATIVE, E_YAML_TABLE_CONFLICT, E_EMPTY_FENCE.

Invalid → table + one-line error. Never drop recovered rows.

## Examples

See examples/valid/01–08 (canonical) and SPEC.md. Natural-language → fence: examples/prompts.md.

## Product boundaries

No d3 in core. No JSON-as-default data. No 7th type. Structure diagrams stay outside this language.
